name: Benchmark V2 Set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: "Number of tasks to run (1-10)"
        required: true
        default: "2"
        type: number
      agent:
        description: "Agent to use"
        required: true
        default: "claude"
        type: string
      provider:
        description: "Provider to use"
        required: true
        default: "anthropic"
        type: string
      model:
        description: "Model to use"
        required: true
        default: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"
        type: string
      timeout:
        description: "Timeout in seconds"
        required: true
        default: "3600"
        type: number

jobs:
  generate-task-list:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      task_ids: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.task_ids }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Generate task list
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          # Read the top reward tasks from the checked-in JSON file
          TASK_IDS=$(cat data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json | jq -r '.task_ids[:${{ github.event.inputs.task_count }}] | join(",")')
          echo "task_ids=$TASK_IDS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  run-benchmarks:
    needs: generate-task-list
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix:
        task_id: ${{ fromJson(format('["{0}"]', needs.generate-task-list.outputs.task_ids)) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Run benchmark for task ${{ matrix.task_id }}
        run: |
          bun run benchmark:v2 \
            --task-id ${{ matrix.task_id }} \
            --agent ${{ github.event.inputs.agent }} \
            --provider ${{ github.event.inputs.provider }} \
            --model ${{ github.event.inputs.model }} \
            --timeout ${{ github.event.inputs.timeout }}

      - name: Upload results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results-${{ matrix.task_id }}
          path: results/${{ matrix.task_id }}
          retention-days: 30
